visual.general_description: Grayscale line chart of systolic blood pressure and body temperature by day with treatment lanes for rhTM, PMX-HP and DOP(γ).
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale chart on a white background with a rectangular plot frame and horizontal gridlines at each left-axis tick; the picture is 358 by 231 pixels. Left axis title SBP (mmHg) with tick labels 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140 and 160; right axis title BT(°C) with tick labels 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39, 40 and 41, each aligned with a gridline. The horizontal axis is titled Day with tick labels -2, -1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 (no label 0); each label is centred in a day-wide interval between short tick marks on the axis. A grey downward triangle labelled Onset sits above the left part of the Day 1 interval, directly over the first marker of Day 1. SBP is drawn as black diamond markers joined by a thick dashed line and labelled SBP; BT is drawn as grey circle markers joined by a thin solid line and labelled BT. Each series has 23 markers: single isolated markers at Day -2 and Day -1 that are not joined to the later line, then three markers in each day interval from Day 1 to Day 7. SBP markers start low at Day 1 and stay low through Day 2, rise during Day 3, reach a peak at the second marker of Day 6 and end slightly lower at Day 7; the two isolated markers before Day 1 lie higher than the early Day 1 markers. BT markers start high at Day 1, reach their highest level at the first and third markers of Day 2, fall at the first marker of Day 3 and then stay lower with small fluctuations; the two isolated markers before Day 1 lie lower than the Day 1 markers. A lane labelled rhTM below the lines holds five small hatched rectangles, one in each interval from Day 2 to Day 6. A lane labelled PMX-HP holds two dark grey squares: the first in the right end of the Day 2 interval and the second in the left half of the Day 3 interval. A lane labelled DOP(γ) holds three adjacent boxes printed 5, 10 and 5: a light grey box starting in the right part of the Day 1 interval, a darker grey box inside the Day 2 interval and a light grey box ending just inside the Day 3 interval. Where an SBP diamond and a BT circle overlap (first and third markers of Day 3 and first marker of Day 4) the hidden marker is only partly visible.
